# TJNAI

> TJNAI.ai LLC is an independent AI creative studio in North Carolina. It builds
> digital avatars, native iOS apps, and AI-generated video and imagery — and ships
> real products, including PickleRecord on the Apple App Store.

## Products

- [PickleRecord](https://picklerecord.app): Pickleball match tracker for iPhone and
  Apple Watch. Keeps your win–loss record, logs games from the wrist, no account
  required — data stays on device. Live on the App Store:
  https://apps.apple.com/app/id6792869715
- Tianna: TJNAI's AI-generated digital avatar — one consistent identity across
  photography, video, and a voice agent in development.
  Gallery: https://tjnai.ai/tianna-intro.html

## Services

- Digital avatars: consistent AI-generated brand identities across imagery and video
- iOS app development: native Swift apps, concept to App Store, AI-assisted engineering
- AI video & imagery: generated and AI-enhanced visual content produced to brief
- AI asset packaging: deliverables with structured metadata (prompt lineage, style
  parameters, tags)
